sanskrit_iast: āhavanīyaṃ yajamānamātradīrghacaturasraṃ vihṛtya tāvatīṃ rajjumabhyasya madhye lakṣaṇaṃ kṛtvā dakṣiṇayoḥ śroṇyaṃsayorantau niyamya lakṣaṇena dakṣiṇānāyamya nimittakārātinimitte rajjuṃ niyamyāntau samasya dakṣiṇāyāḥ śroṇerdakṣiṇamaṃsamanulikhedevamevottaratastiryaṅmānīṃ dviguṇāṃ tathā kṛtvā purastātpaścāccopalikhet
meaning: आहवनीयं यजमानमात्रदीर्घचतुरस्रं विहृत्य तावतीं रज्जुमभ्यस्य मध्ये लक्षणं कृत्वा दक्षिणयोः श्रोण्यंसयोरन्तौ नियम्य लक्षणेन दक्षिणानायम्य निमित्तकारातिनिमित्ते रज्जुं नियम्यान्तौ समस्य दक्षिणायाः श्रोणेर्दक्षिणमंसमनुलिखेदेवमेवोत्तरतस्तिर्यङ्मानीं द्विगुणां तथा कृत्वा पुरस्तात्पश्चाच्चोपलिखेत्

sanskrit_iast: aratniścaturasrastu pūrvasyāgneḥ kharaḥ smṛtaḥ rathacakrākṛtiḥ paścāccandrārddha iva dakṣiṇaḥ
meaning: अरत्निश्चतुरस्रस्तु पूर्वस्याग्नेः खरः स्मृतः रथचक्राकृतिः पश्चाच्चन्द्रार्द्ध इव दक्षिणः

sanskrit_iast: maṇḍale parilekhaḥ syādyavonāni caturdaśa parilekhārddhacandre syātsārddhā hyekonaviṃśatiḥ
meaning: मण्डले परिलेखः स्याद्यवोनानि चतुर्दश परिलेखार्द्धचन्द्रे स्यात्सार्द्धा ह्येकोनविंशतिः

sanskrit_iast: sikatānāṃ kharaṃ kuryādagnerāyatanaṃ hi tat uddhatāvokṣataṃ kṛtvā sphyena kurvīta lakṣaṇam
meaning: सिकतानां खरं कुर्यादग्नेरायतनं हि तत् उद्धतावोक्षतं कृत्वा स्फ्येन कुर्वीत लक्षणम्

sanskrit_iast: kharapramāṇā rekhāḥ ṣaḍ udīcī prathamā bhavet pañca prācyastato rekhā dakṣiṇe cottare pṛthak
meaning: खरप्रमाणा रेखाः षड् उदीची प्रथमा भवेत् पञ्च प्राच्यस्ततो रेखा दक्षिणे चोत्तरे पृथक्

sanskrit_iast: tayormadhye punaścānye tayormadhye tu pañcamī rekhāṇāmanupūrveṇa devatāḥ samprakīrtitāḥ
meaning: तयोर्मध्ये पुनश्चान्ये तयोर्मध्ये तु पञ्चमी रेखाणामनुपूर्वेण देवताः सम्प्रकीर्तिताः

sanskrit_iast: pṛthivyagniśca vāyuśca somaścendraḥ prajāpatiḥ lakṣaṇe tu kṛte tasminnagneḥ praṇayanaṃ bhavet
meaning: पृथिव्यग्निश्च वायुश्च सोमश्चेन्द्रः प्रजापतिः लक्षणे तु कृते तस्मिन्नग्नेः प्रणयनं भवेत्

sanskrit_iast: aṇīyasyāścaturhastāṃ rajjuṃ mitvā tridhā bhajet madhyaṃ caturddhā saṃbhujya madhyamaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ bhavet pūrvāt tribhāgātpaścārddhe turye dadyācca lakṣaṇam
meaning: अणीयस्याश्चतुर्हस्तां रज्जुं मित्वा त्रिधा भजेत् मध्यं चतुर्द्धा संभुज्य मध्यमं लक्षणं भवेत् पूर्वात् त्रिभागात्पश्चार्द्धे तुर्ये दद्याच्च लक्षणम्

sanskrit_iast: saurayyavihitā vediḥ śulbavijñānasaṃmitā
meaning: सौरय्यविहिता वेदिः शुल्बविज्ञानसंमिता

sanskrit_iast: dārśikī ṣaṭśayā turye sapta saptadaśaiva tat ekaṃ dvau pañca tairmitvā samaraiḥ parilekhayet
meaning: दार्शिकी षट्शया तुर्ये सप्त सप्तदशैव तत् एकं द्वौ पञ्च तैर्मित्वा समरैः परिलेखयेत्

sanskrit_iast: maitrāyaṇīya śulba sūtra pāśātpāśastu prācyarddhe madhye dadyācca lakṣaṇam madhyātturīye nirāyāmo vistārastvardhato bhavet
meaning: मैत्रायणीय शुल्ब सूत्र पाशात्पाशस्तु प्राच्यर्द्धे मध्ये दद्याच्च लक्षणम् मध्यात्तुरीये निरायामो विस्तारस्त्वर्धतो भवेत्
text_mt:
Now begins the Maitrāyaṇīya-śulbasūtra.

Having measured a four-cubit cord of the thinner [type], he should divide it threefold; / having folded the middle fourfold, the central mark is made; / and one should place a mark at the fourth part in the western half from the eastern third.

Maitrāyaṇīya-śulbasūtra: / One loop from the [other] loop in the eastern half, and one should place a mark in the middle; / from the middle in the fourth part is the longitudinal stretch, but the breadth should be half.

sanskrit_iast: prācyarddhe lakṣaṇaṃ dadyāccaturbhāge nirañcanam tato'parasmin śaṅkvarthe dadyātpañcakasaptake
meaning: प्राच्यर्द्धे लक्षणं दद्याच्चतुर्भागे निरञ्चनम् ततोऽपरस्मिन् शङ्क्वर्थे दद्यात्पञ्चकसप्तके
text_mt: He should place a mark in the eastern half, an unblemished mark in the fourth part; / then at the other peg-point he should place [marks] at five and seven;

sanskrit_iast: tato'parasmin śaṅkvarthe rajjuśca dviguṇā bhavet navaśayā pāśābhyāmarddhatṛtīyayorlakṣaṇe dviśaye'parasmātpūrvasmādadhyarddhe ṣaṭsu pāśaṃ pratimucyāparasmādarddhatṛtīye gṛhītvā dakṣiṇā nirāyamya dvayoḥ śaṅkue
meaning: ततोऽपरस्मिन् शङ्क्वर्थे रज्जुश्च द्विगुणा भवेत् नवशया पाशाभ्यामर्द्धतृतीययोर्लक्षणे द्विशयेऽपरस्मात्पूर्वस्मादध्यर्द्धे षट्सु पाशं प्रतिमुच्यापरस्मादर्द्धतृतीये गृहीत्वा दक्षिणा निरायम्य द्वयोः शङ्कुए

sanskrit_iast: nihanyādevamevottarataḥ pūrvasmādarddhatṛtīye gṛhītvā dakṣiṇā nirāyamyādhyarddhe śaṅkue nihanyādevamevottarataḥ
meaning: निहन्यादेवमेवोत्तरतः पूर्वस्मादर्द्धतृतीये गृहीत्वा दक्षिणा निरायम्याध्यर्द्धे शङ्कुए निहन्यादेवमेवोत्तरतः
text_mt: he should drive [the peg] in; in the very same way on the north; taking [it] at two and a half from the eastern [peg], having stretched it out southward, at one and a half, at the peg / he should drive [the peg] in; in the very same way on the north.

sanskrit_iast: dviguṇe lakṣaṇaṃ dadyāddadyāccaiva caturguṇe mūlācca triguṇe dadyātpañcāṅgī procyate hi sā paritanoti śayaikā ca dvipāśottaravedikī
meaning: द्विगुणे लक्षणं दद्याद्दद्याच्चैव चतुर्गुणे मूलाच्च त्रिगुणे दद्यात्पञ्चाङ्गी प्रोच्यते हि सा परितनोति शयैका च द्विपाशोत्तरवेदिकी
text_mt: One should place a mark at the double, and place [one] also at the quadruple; / and from the base one should place [one] at the triple; that is indeed declared to have five limbs; / and one śaya extends around, belonging to the high altar with two loops.

sanskrit_iast: madhye tu lakṣaṇaṃ dadyādubhayoścāntamadhyayoḥ
meaning: मध्ये तु लक्षणं दद्यादुभयोश्चान्तमध्ययोः
text_mt: And in the middle one should place a mark, and between the ends and the middle of both.

sanskrit_iast: dviśaye'rddhaśaye'rddhacaturthaśaye śayārddhe śaya eva ca adhyarddhaśayena pātitayā pāśukī vedirucyate
meaning: द्विशयेऽर्द्धशयेऽर्द्धचतुर्थशये शयार्द्धे शय एव च अध्यर्द्धशयेन पातितया पाशुकी वेदिरुच्यते
text_mt: At two śayas, half a śaya, three and a half śayas, half a śaya, and one śaya; / by [the cord] laid down with one and a half śayas, the altar for animal sacrifice is stated.

sanskrit_iast: pāśādarddhaśayebhyaḥ pañcanitodāḥ śayāśca ṣaṭ prācī triśaye ca bhavetpāśaḥ pāśukī vedirucyate
meaning: पाशादर्द्धशयेभ्यः पञ्चनितोदाः शयाश्च षट् प्राची त्रिशये च भवेत्पाशः पाशुकी वेदिरुच्यते
text_mt: From the loop for half-śayas, five nitodas and six śayas is the eastward [length]; / and at three śayas should be a loop; the altar for animal sacrifice is stated.

sanskrit_iast: triguṇāyā rajjoḥ pāśaṃ kṛtvā pāśādūrdhvaṃ navaśayaṃ mitvā pāśukyuttaravedirvyākhyātā
meaning: त्रिगुणाया रज्जोः पाशं कृत्वा पाशादूर्ध्वं नवशयं मित्वा पाशुक्युत्तरवेदिर्व्याख्याता
text_mt: Having made a loop in a tripled cord, having measured nine śayas above the loop, / the high altar (uttaravedi) for the animal sacrifice is explained.

sanskrit_iast: varuṇapraghāseṣūttarāyā arddhaṃ pratiprasthātā karoti tiryaksamāṃ prācīm
meaning: वरुणप्रघासेषूत्तराया अर्द्धं प्रतिप्रस्थाता करोति तिर्यक्समां प्राचीम्
text_mt: In the Varuṇapraghāsa rites, the Pratiprasthātṛ makes half of the northern [altar], its eastward line equal to the transverse.

sanskrit_iast: śayā rajjorvidhātavyāḥ ṣaṭbhāgonāstrayodaśa mārutīṃ vāruṇīṃ caiva saha vediṃ mimīṣatā
meaning: शया रज्जोर्विधातव्याः षट्भागोनास्त्रयोदश मारुतीं वारुणीं चैव सह वेदिं मिमीषता
text_mt: Thirteen śayas less a sixth part of the cord are to be prepared / by one wishing to measure the altar of the Maruts and of Varuṇa together;

sanskrit_iast: pāśād dvayoḥ śaye tasmāddvayoranyattataḥ śaye pūrvātpāśācchaye'dhyarddhe tato'nyatpādahīnayoḥ
meaning: पाशाद् द्वयोः शये तस्माद्द्वयोरन्यत्ततः शये पूर्वात्पाशाच्छयेऽध्यर्द्धे ततोऽन्यत्पादहीनयोः
text_mt: from the loop at two śayas; from that, the other at two; then at a śaya; / from the eastern loop at one and a half śayas; then the other at those reduced by a quarter;

sanskrit_iast: tato'dhyarddhe tataḥ pāde kḷpte mārutī vāruṇī
meaning: ततोऽध्यर्द्धे ततः पादे कॢप्ते मारुती वारुणी
text_mt: then at one and a half; then at a quarter: [thus] the Marut and Varuṇa [altars] are prepared.

sanskrit_iast: puruṣe syānnirāyāmaḥ prācyarddhaṣaṣṭhavarjitaḥ tataḥ saṣaṣṭhārddhoṃ'saḥ syād dikkuṣṭhā paitṛkī smṛtā
meaning: पुरुषे स्यान्निरायामः प्राच्यर्द्धषष्ठवर्जितः ततः सषष्ठार्द्धोंऽसः स्याद् दिक्कुष्ठा पैतृकी स्मृता
text_mt: The longitudinal stretch should be a puruṣa, lacking one-sixth of the eastern half; / then the shoulder should be half plus one-sixth; the [altar] for ancestral rites is declared to have the points of the compass as its corners.

sanskrit_iast: rajjuḥ śayārddhaṣaṣṭhā sā sāṅgulā tanuyājñikī caturṣu ṣaḍaṅguloneṣu sārddhe ca śaye sapāde'nyat
meaning: रज्जुः शयार्द्धषष्ठा सा साङ्गुला तनुयाज्ञिकी चतुर्षु षडङ्गुलोनेषु सार्द्धे च शये सपादेऽन्यत्
text_mt: The cord is five and a half śayas, with a finger-breadth, for the slim sacrificer; / at four [śayas] less six finger-breadths, and at one and a half śayas, the other is with a quarter [śaya];

sanskrit_iast: ṣaḍaṅgulonāścatvāraḥ prācī paścāt śayatrayā pūrvārddhe'rddhatṛtīyā syātsā vediḥ pākayājñikī
meaning: षडङ्गुलोनाश्चत्वारः प्राची पश्चात् शयत्रया पूर्वार्द्धेऽर्द्धतृतीया स्यात्सा वेदिः पाकयाज्ञिकी
text_mt: four [śayas] less six finger-breadths is the eastward length, three śayas behind; / in the eastern half it should be two and a half; that is the altar for the domestic sacrifice (pākayajña).

sanskrit_iast: dviguṇā śatasāhasre koṭyāṃ pañcaguṇā bhavet
meaning: द्विगुणा शतसाहस्रे कोट्यां पञ्चगुणा भवेत्
text_mt: It should be doubled in the hundred-thousand [ritual], fivefold in the crore.

sanskrit_iast: khaṇḍamaṇḍalayoścaiva tribhāgamavaśeṣayan dhiṣṇyaṃ tatra prakurvīta yavonāni caturdaśa
meaning: खण्डमण्डलयोश्चैव त्रिभागमवशेषयन् धिष्ण्यं तत्र प्रकुर्वीत यवोनानि चतुर्दश
text_mt: Leaving aside a third part of both the crescent and the circle, / one should construct a dhiṣṇya there, fourteen [aṅgulas] less [a few] barleycorns;

sanskrit_iast: api ca satryaṅgulaṃ śayaṃ mitvā sarvataḥ parilekhayet
meaning: अपि च सत्र्यङ्गुलं शयं मित्वा सर्वतः परिलेखयेत्
text_mt: moreover, having measured a śaya plus three aṅgulas, one should trace around on all sides.

sanskrit_iast: dviguṇaṃ tu punarmadhye uttaraṃ ca caturguṇam kuryādaupāsanīyasya pākayajñavidhiṣu ca
meaning: द्विगुणं तु पुनर्मध्ये उत्तरं च चतुर्गुणम् कुर्यादौपासनीयस्य पाकयज्ञविधिषु च
text_mt: Double again in the middle, and quadruple to the north, / one should make for the domestic fire in the rites of the pākayajña.

sanskrit_iast: tvacobilaṃ dārumayaṃ mūlato'bhrimayūkhakam syāttiryagīṣāmātro mayūkhaḥ prādeśamātro vā
meaning: त्वचोबिलं दारुमयं मूलतोऽभ्रिमयूखकम् स्यात्तिर्यगीषामात्रो मयूखः प्रादेशमात्रो वा
text_mt: The rim is of wood with bark, with a peg [and] shovel at the base; / the peg should be across, the size of a pole, or the measure of a span.

sanskrit_iast: ṛjavaḥ śaṅkavaḥ kāryāḥ khādirā vaiṇavā api dvādaśāṅgulaparyantā dvyaṅulaṃ pariṇāhajāḥ
meaning: ऋजवः शङ्कवः कार्याः खादिरा वैणवा अपि द्वादशाङ्गुलपर्यन्ता द्व्यङुलं परिणाहजाः
text_mt: Straight pegs must be made of khadira or of bamboo, / up to twelve aṅgulas [in length], two aṅgulas in girth.

sanskrit_iast: yūpamūlaṃ rajjvā parigṛhya caturddhā saṃbhujya rarāṭe pratimucya sarvato'nulikhet
meaning: यूपमूलं रज्ज्वा परिगृह्य चतुर्द्धा संभुज्य रराटे प्रतिमुच्य सर्वतोऽनुलिखेत्
text_mt: Having encircled the base of the sacrificial post with a cord, having folded it fourfold, having fastened it at the forehead, he should trace [a line] all around.

sanskrit_iast: padaṃ pañcadaśāṅgulaṃ yāvatpadaṃ vā
meaning: पदं पञ्चदशाङ्गुलं यावत्पदं वा
text_mt: A foot (pada) is fifteen aṅgulas, or the length of a foot.

sanskrit_iast: śayaścaturviṃśatyaṅgulaḥ proktaḥ pañcaviṃśasyaṅgulo vā | prādeśe dvādaśāṅgulaḥ
meaning: शयश्चतुर्विंशत्यङ्गुलः प्रोक्तः पञ्चविंशस्यङ्गुलो वा । प्रादेशे द्वादशाङ्गुलः
text_mt: A śaya is said to be twenty-four aṅgulas, or twenty-five aṅgulas; a span (prādeśa) is twelve aṅgulas.

sanskrit_iast: adhvaryoḥ parimāṇāni adhikārāt | dārukārasyaike | yajamānasya vā svāmitvāt
meaning: अध्वर्योः परिमाणानि अधिकारात् । दारुकारस्यैके । यजमानस्य वा स्वामित्वात्
text_mt: The measures are those of the Adhvaryu, by virtue of his authority; of the carpenter, say some; or of the sacrificer, / because of ownership.

sanskrit_iast: dvipadaḥ prakramastripado'rddhatripado vā pañcapadastveva sāgnikaḥ
meaning: द्विपदः प्रक्रमस्त्रिपदोऽर्द्धत्रिपदो वा पञ्चपदस्त्वेव साग्निकः
text_mt: A step (prakrama) is two padas, three padas, or two and a half padas; but that for the Agnicayana is five padas.

sanskrit_iast: pṛṣṭhyāśaṅkau pāśaṃ pratimucya prācīmāyamya pañcadaśasu lakṣaṇaṃ tatastvekaviṃśatyāṃ tatasdviṣu tatastriṣu tato dvādaśasu pāśaṃ karoti | tat ṣaṭtriṃśe pratimucyāparasmāttataḥ pañcadaśasu gṛhītvā dakṣiṇā nirāyamya pañcadaśasu śaṅkue nihanyādevamevottarataḥ | pūrvasmātpañcadaśasu gṛhītvā dakṣiṇā nirāyamya dvādaśasu śaṅkue nihanyādevamevottarataḥ | paritastanoti
meaning: पृष्ठ्याशङ्कौ पाशं प्रतिमुच्य प्राचीमायम्य पञ्चदशसु लक्षणं ततस्त्वेकविंशत्यां ततस्द्विषु ततस्त्रिषु ततो द्वादशसु पाशं करोति । तत् षट्त्रिंशे प्रतिमुच्यापरस्मात्ततः पञ्चदशसु गृहीत्वा दक्षिणा निरायम्य पञ्चदशसु शङ्कुए निहन्यादेवमेवोत्तरतः । पूर्वस्मात्पञ्चदशसु गृहीत्वा दक्षिणा निरायम्य द्वादशसु शङ्कुए निहन्यादेवमेवोत्तरतः । परितस्तनोति

sanskrit_iast: pramāya rajjuṃ daśabhīrathākṣairekādaśaiścoparabudhnamātraiḥ tasyāścaturviṃśatibhāgadheyamekādaśinīṃ prativedimāhuḥ
meaning: प्रमाय रज्जुं दशभीरथाक्षैरेकादशैश्चोपरबुध्नमात्रैः तस्याश्चतुर्विंशतिभागधेयमेकादशिनीं प्रतिवेदिमाहुः
text_mt: Having measured the cord by ten axletrees and by eleven of the size of the bottom of the upper pressing-board, / one twenty-fourth part of that they call the set of eleven posts for each altar.

sanskrit_iast: catvāriṃśatiraṣṭau ca aṅgulāni samāsataḥ ekādaśinyā māne'smin prakramaṃ kavayo viduḥ
meaning: चत्वारिंशतिरष्टौ च अङ्गुलानि समासतः एकादशिन्या मानेऽस्मिन् प्रक्रमं कवयो विदुः
text_mt: Forty-eight aṅgulas, in summary, / the wise know to be the prakrama in this measurement of the eleven [posts].

sanskrit_iast: aṅgulāni pramāyāṣṭau vedyagrādarddhamullikhet
meaning: अङ्गुलानि प्रमायाष्टौ वेद्यग्रादर्द्धमुल्लिखेत्
text_mt: Having measured eight aṅgulas, he should trace out half from the tip of the altar;

sanskrit_iast: taṃ prāñcaṃ prasamīkṣeta etāṃ vidyācchikhaṇḍinīm
meaning: तं प्राञ्चं प्रसमीक्षेत एतां विद्याच्छिखण्डिनीम्
text_mt: he should look along that eastward; one should know this as the crested [altar] (śikhaṇḍinī);

sanskrit_iast: etenaiva tulyena indravajraśikhaṇḍinīm
meaning: एतेनैव तुल्येन इन्द्रवज्रशिखण्डिनीम्
text_mt: by this very equal [measure], the Indra's-thunderbolt crested [altar] (indravajraśikhaṇḍinī).

sanskrit_iast: ekādaśasu kartavyā budhnā vediprasiddhaye
meaning: एकादशसु कर्तव्या बुध्ना वेदिप्रसिद्धये
text_mt: The bases must be made at eleven [positions] to accomplish the altar.

sanskrit_iast: saṃśayo yatra jāyeta arddhaṃ yūpāvaṭe yadi agniṣṭhena tu te sarve avaruddhā bhavanti te
meaning: संशयो यत्र जायेत अर्द्धं यूपावटे यदि अग्निष्ठेन तु ते सर्वे अवरुद्धा भवन्ति ते
text_mt: Where doubt should arise, if half [falls] in the post-hole, / they are all contained by the post opposite the Agni (agniṣṭha).

sanskrit_iast: prakrameṇa samaṃ mitvā caturasraṃ tu maṇḍalam kuryātsakalenārddhena bhrāmayitvā'sya madhyataḥ
meaning: प्रक्रमेण समं मित्वा चतुरस्रं तु मण्डलम् कुर्यात्सकलेनार्द्धेन भ्रामयित्वाऽस्य मध्यतः
text_mt: One should make [it] with the whole half, having rotated it from its center;

sanskrit_iast: mitvā tadakṣṇayārajjvā tataḥ kuryāttu maṇḍalam punastadakṣṇayā-rajjvā hṛtvā'rddhamatirekataḥ
meaning: मित्वा तदक्ष्णयारज्ज्वा ततः कुर्यात्तु मण्डलम् पुनस्तदक्ष्णया-रज्ज्वा हृत्वाऽर्द्धमतिरेकतः
text_mt: again, having taken half with that diagonal cord from the excess,

sanskrit_iast: prakramārthaṃ tu tāṃ kuryādvedyāmaśvamakhasya ca
meaning: प्रक्रमार्थं तु तां कुर्याद्वेद्यामश्वमखस्य च
text_mt: one should make that for the sake of the prakrama on the altar of the Horse Sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast: anenaiva vidhānena pañcadhā daśadhā'kṣṇayā vedī krameṇa te syātāṃ pauruṣī sārvamedhinī
meaning: अनेनैव विधानेन पञ्चधा दशधाऽक्ष्णया वेदी क्रमेण ते स्यातां पौरुषी सार्वमेधिनी
text_mt: By this very rule, fivefold [and] tenfold by the diagonal, / those two altars should be in order: the one measuring a man, [and] that of the All-Sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast: tripadā pārśvamānī syāttiryaṅmānī padaṃ bhavet tasyākṣṇayā tu yā rajjuḥ kuryāddaśapadā hi sā
meaning: त्रिपदा पार्श्वमानी स्यात्तिर्यङ्मानी पदं भवेत् तस्याक्ष्णया तु या रज्जुः कुर्याद्दशपदा हि सा
text_mt: The side-measurer should be three feet, the transverse-measurer should be one foot; / the cord that is its diagonal, however, makes indeed ten feet.

sanskrit_iast: aṣṭādaśāratnīmubhayataḥpāśāṃ kṛtvā madhye lakṣaṇam | tatastayorarddhayoraparamantaṃ yathāpraviṣṭaṃ pañcāṅgīkṛtvā prācīmāyamya yathāpradiṣṭaṃ lakṣaṇāsu śaṅkūn nihanyāt unmucyābhito madhyame pāśau pratimucya dakṣiṇā nirāyamya todaṃ karoti unmucyābhito madhye pāśaṃ pratimucya dakṣiṇā nirāyamya todasyādhyadhihṛtyārddhacaturdaśasu śaṅkue nihanyāt | madhyamātpāśamunmucya pūrvārddhaṃ pratimucya dakṣiṇārddhe tu dakṣiṇāṃ prācīṃ samāyamyārddhapañcameṣu śaṅkue nihanyāt | pūrvārddhātpāśamunmucya paścārddhe pratimucya dakṣiṇārddhe tu dakṣiṇāṃ prācīmāyamyārddhapañcameṣu śaṅkue nihanyāt | evamevottarataḥ | paritastanoti | sado vyākhyāsyāmaḥ
meaning: अष्टादशारत्नीमुभयतःपाशां कृत्वा मध्ये लक्षणम् । ततस्तयोरर्द्धयोरपरमन्तं यथाप्रविष्टं पञ्चाङ्गीकृत्वा प्राचीमायम्य यथाप्रदिष्टं लक्षणासु शङ्कून् निहन्यात् उन्मुच्याभितो मध्यमे पाशौ प्रतिमुच्य दक्षिणा निरायम्य तोदं करोति उन्मुच्याभितो मध्ये पाशं प्रतिमुच्य दक्षिणा निरायम्य तोदस्याध्यधिहृत्यार्द्धचतुर्दशसु शङ्कुए निहन्यात् । मध्यमात्पाशमुन्मुच्य पूर्वार्द्धं प्रतिमुच्य दक्षिणार्द्धे तु दक्षिणां प्राचीं समायम्यार्द्धपञ्चमेषु शङ्कुए निहन्यात् । पूर्वार्द्धात्पाशमुन्मुच्य पश्चार्द्धे प्रतिमुच्य दक्षिणार्द्धे तु दक्षिणां प्राचीमायम्यार्द्धपञ्चमेषु शङ्कुए निहन्यात् । एवमेवोत्तरतः । परितस्तनोति । सदो व्याख्यास्यामः
text_mt:
Having made [a cord] of eighteen cubits with loops at both ends, [one makes] a mark in the middle. Then the other end of those two halves,

divided into five parts according to the entrance, having stretched along the east, one drives pegs at the marks as prescribed.

Having unfastened [it] on both sides, having fastened the loops at the middle peg, having stretched toward the south, he makes the mark.

Having unfastened [it] on both sides, having fastened the loop at the middle peg, having stretched out toward the south, having shifted above that mark, he drives a peg at thirteen and a half [units]. Having unfastened the loop from the middle peg, having fastened the eastern half,

in the southern half, having stretched out southward [and] eastward, he drives a peg at four and a half [units]. Having unfastened the loop from the eastern half, having fastened [it] in the western half, in the southern half, having stretched out southward [and] eastward, he drives a peg at four and a half [units]. In the very same way toward the north. He encloses it all around. We shall explain the sadas.

sanskrit_iast: sado madhyamarekhā yā dakṣiṇodīcī nirāyattā tasyāḥ prācīṃ vasutriṃśattyaktvā dhiṣṇyāni kārayet
meaning: सदो मध्यमरेखा या दक्षिणोदीची निरायत्ता तस्याः प्राचीं वसुत्रिंशत्त्यक्त्वा धिष्ण्यानि कारयेत्
text_mt: The central line of the sadas, which extends south and north: having set off thirty-eight [units] to the east of it, one should make the dhiṣṇya hearths.

sanskrit_iast: aṣṭāviṃśāṅgulā dhiṣṇyā dvācatvāriṃśāṅgulāntarāḥ
meaning: अष्टाविंशाङ्गुला धिष्ण्या द्वाचत्वारिंशाङ्गुलान्तराः
text_mt: The dhiṣṇya hearths are twenty-eight finger-breadths [wide], with intervals of forty-two finger-breadths.

sanskrit_iast: aṃsāduttarato'dhyarddhe śaṅkuḥ śroṇyāśca dakṣiṇe āgnīdhre sā bhavetprācī tayormadhye tu saṅgamam
meaning: अंसादुत्तरतोऽध्यर्द्धे शङ्कुः श्रोण्याश्च दक्षिणे आग्नीध्रे सा भवेत्प्राची तयोर्मध्ये तु सङ्गमम्
text_mt: A peg is placed north of the shoulder at one and a half [units], and south of the hip; / that becomes the east-line for the Āgnīdhra; between them is the junction.

sanskrit_iast: āgnīdhraṃ ṣaṭśayaṃ bhavet
meaning: आग्नीध्रं षट्शयं भवेत्
text_mt: The Āgnīdhra shed should be six spans [long].

sanskrit_iast: prāgvaṃśaṃ daśahastaṃ syāt
meaning: प्राग्वंशं दशहस्तं स्यात्
text_mt: The hall with eastern rafters should be ten cubits.

sanskrit_iast: patnīśālaṃ catuḥśayam
meaning: पत्नीशालं चतुःशयम्
text_mt: The hall for the sacrificer's wife should be four spans.

sanskrit_iast: sarvā viṃśaśayā rajjuḥ śaye dadyācca lakṣaṇam pāśācca pañcake dadyātpāśādarddhāṣṭameṣu ca
meaning: सर्वा विंशशया रज्जुः शये दद्याच्च लक्षणम् पाशाच्च पञ्चके दद्यात्पाशादर्द्धाष्टमेषु च
text_mt: The entire cord is twenty spans; one should make a mark at a span, / and one should make [a mark] at the fifth [span] from the loop, and at seven and a half [spans] from the loop.

sanskrit_iast: śayapañcamayormadhye upastambhanalakṣaṇam tatastvekaviṃśatyāṃ maṇḍaleṣveva lakṣaṇaiḥ
meaning: शयपञ्चमयोर्मध्ये उपस्तम्भनलक्षणम् ततस्त्वेकविंशत्यां मण्डलेष्वेव लक्षणैः
text_mt: Between the span and the fifth [mark] is the prop-mark; / then at twenty-one, with marks on the circles themselves;

sanskrit_iast: aṅguliṣu punarmitvā dvādaśasveva śulbavit prajñāte lakṣaṇe dadyādupastambhanalakṣaṇāt
meaning: अङ्गुलिषु पुनर्मित्वा द्वादशस्वेव शुल्बवित् प्रज्ञाते लक्षणे दद्यादुपस्तम्भनलक्षणात्
text_mt: having measured again by finger-breadths, at twelve [finger-breadths] the cord-knower / should place [a mark] at the known mark from the prop-mark;

sanskrit_iast: pūrvātpāśādbāhau tato'nyaḥ pañcadaśasu tato'nyo'ṣṭāsvaṅgulīṣu pūrvavad dvādaśasu caturviṃśatisu cānyat
meaning: पूर्वात्पाशाद्बाहौ ततोऽन्यः पञ्चदशसु ततोऽन्योऽष्टास्वङ्गुलीषु पूर्ववद् द्वादशसु चतुर्विंशतिसु चान्यत्
text_mt: from the eastern loop at a fathom; then another at fifteen; then another at eight finger-breadths; as before, at twelve, and another at twenty-four.

sanskrit_iast: eka eva śaye śaṅkuḥ śiṣṭāḥ pañcadaśādiṣu
meaning: एक एव शये शङ्कुः शिष्टाः पञ्चदशादिषु
text_mt: There is only one peg at the span; the rest are at the fifteen [finger-breadths] and so forth,

sanskrit_iast: kharoparavopastambhanamethīṣṭhādvāryupadvāryāḥ prasiddhyartham
meaning: खरोपरवोपस्तम्भनमेथीष्ठाद्वार्युपद्वार्याः प्रसिद्ध्यर्थम्
text_mt: for the purpose of establishing the mound, the sounding holes, the prop, the post, the door-post, and the side door-post.

sanskrit_iast: dvāryā vistārayormadhye bāhurdeyastu lakṣaṇam
meaning: द्वार्या विस्तारयोर्मध्ये बाहुर्देयस्तु लक्षणम्
text_mt: Between the two widths of the door-post, an arm-length mark should be placed.

sanskrit_iast: etenaiva tu kalpena pratīcīmeva hārayet
meaning: एतेनैव तु कल्पेन प्रतीचीमेव हारयेत्
text_mt: By this very procedure, one should draw [the cord] toward the west.

sanskrit_iast: prathamatrayapañcamasārddhasaptameṣu rajjumuttarato haret
meaning: प्रथमत्रयपञ्चमसार्द्धसप्तमेषु रज्जुमुत्तरतो हरेत्
text_mt: At the first, third, fifth, and seven and a half [units], one should draw the cord toward the north.

sanskrit_iast: etadeva viparyastaṃ kharaḥ syādvājapeyikaḥ
meaning: एतदेव विपर्यस्तं खरः स्याद्वाजपेयिकः
text_mt: This very [arrangement] reversed becomes the mound of the Vājapeya sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast: caturasraṃ mudgaraṃ kuryāt ṣoḍaśāṅgulamāyatam amadhyaviddhaṃ ramaṇīyaṃ sāradāruvinirmitam
meaning: चतुरस्रं मुद्गरं कुर्यात् षोडशाङ्गुलमायतम् अमध्यविद्धं रमणीयं सारदारुविनिर्मितम्
text_mt: One should make a square mallet sixteen finger-breadths long, / not perforated in the center, delightful, made of heartwood.

sanskrit_iast: mauñjaṃ śulbaṃ sadā kāryaṃ śāṇena parimiśritam manvādayo vadantyevaṃ miśritaṃ kuśabalvajaiḥ
meaning: मौञ्जं शुल्बं सदा कार्यं शाणेन परिमिश्रितम् मन्वादयो वदन्त्येवं मिश्रितं कुशबल्वजैः
text_mt: The cord should always be made of muñja grass, blended with hemp; / Manu and others say that it may be blended with kuśa and balvaja grasses.

sanskrit_iast: ajīrṇā granthinī sūkṣmā samāślakṣṇā hyaromaśā rajjurmānādhikā kāryā adhvare yogamicchatā
meaning: अजीर्णा ग्रन्थिनी सूक्ष्मा समाश्लक्ष्णा ह्यरोमशा रज्जुर्मानाधिका कार्या अध्वरे योगमिच्छता
text_mt: Not worn out, knotless, fine, even, smooth, and hairless, / the cord should be made longer than the measure by one who desires success in the sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast: yathā na kṣoyate mātrā yathā ca na vivarddhate yathā ca ramate dṛṣṭistathā yogaṃ samācaret
meaning: यथा न क्षोयते मात्रा यथा च न विवर्द्धते यथा च रमते दृष्टिस्तथा योगं समाचरेत्
text_mt: So that the measure is not diminished, and so that it does not increase, / and so that the sight is pleased, so one should perform the procedure.

sanskrit_iast: tantū puṣkaranālasya triguṇaṃ yad dṛḍhaṃ bhavet trihāyanyā vatsataryā bālena samamucyate
meaning: तन्तू पुष्करनालस्य त्रिगुणं यद् दृढं भवेत् त्रिहायन्या वत्सतर्या बालेन सममुच्यते
text_mt: A thread of lotus-stalk, threefold, which is strong, / is said to be equal to a hair of a three-year-old heifer.

sanskrit_iast: tribālaṃ sarṣapaṃ vidyādyavaṃ vidyāttrisarṣapam triyavaṃ kṛṣṇalaṃ vidyātmānaṃ vidyāttrikṛṣṇalam
meaning: त्रिबालं सर्षपं विद्याद्यवं विद्यात्त्रिसर्षपम् त्रियवं कृष्णलं विद्यात्मानं विद्यात्त्रिकृष्णलम्
text_mt: Three hairs should be known as a mustard seed; a barleycorn should be known as three mustard seeds; / three barleycorns should be known as a kṛṣṇala; a māna should be known as three kṛṣṇalas.

sanskrit_iast: kṛṣṇalānāṃ catuḥṣaṣṭiḥ sauvarṇo māna ucyate mānastvekonapañcāśanniṣka ityabhidhīyate
meaning: कृष्णलानां चतुःषष्टिः सौवर्णो मान उच्यते मानस्त्वेकोनपञ्चाशन्निष्क इत्यभिधीयते
text_mt: Sixty-four kṛṣṇalas are called a golden māna; / forty-nine mānas are called a niṣka.

sanskrit_iast: harītakyākṛtirniṣko rukmastu parimaṇḍalaḥ
meaning: हरीतक्याकृतिर्निष्को रुक्मस्तु परिमण्डलः
text_mt: The niṣka is shaped like a myrobalan fruit; the rukma, however, is circular.

sanskrit_iast: trīṇi niṣkasahasrāṇi trīṇi niṣkaśatāni ca aṣṭāviṃśaṃ śataṃ caiva dadyād bahusuvarṇake
meaning: त्रीणि निष्कसहस्राणि त्रीणि निष्कशतानि च अष्टाविंशं शतं चैव दद्याद् बहुसुवर्णके
text_mt: Three thousand niṣkas, and three hundred niṣkas, / and also one hundred and twenty-eight, one should give in the Bahusuvarṇaka sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast: puruṣo'ṅgulimānena bhaved viṃśaśatāṅgulaḥ ūrdhvabāhurūrdhvapāṇiḥ prapadābhyāṃ pratiṣṭhitaḥ
meaning: पुरुषोऽङ्गुलिमानेन भवेद् विंशशताङ्गुलः ऊर्ध्वबाहुरूर्ध्वपाणिः प्रपदाभ्यां प्रतिष्ठितः
text_mt: A man by finger-breadth measure is one hundred and twenty finger-breadths, / with arms raised, hands raised, standing on the tips of the feet.

sanskrit_iast: atha cetprapadotthānaḥ pañcamoṃ'śaḥ śayo bhavet
meaning: अथ चेत्प्रपदोत्थानः पञ्चमोंऽशः शयो भवेत्
text_mt: Now, if he is standing on the balls of the feet, the fifth part is a span.

sanskrit_iast: aṅgulyāstu pramāṇaṃ syāt ṣaḍyavāḥ pārśvasaṃhitāḥ
meaning: अङ्गुल्यास्तु प्रमाणं स्यात् षड्यवाः पार्श्वसंहिताः
text_mt: The measure of a finger-breadth is six barleycorns joined side by side,

sanskrit_iast: arogaścāvipīvā ca hyambusiktastu yo yavaḥ
meaning: अरोगश्चाविपीवा च ह्यम्बुसिक्तस्तु यो यवः
text_mt: a barleycorn that is free of disease, not bloated, and sprinkled with water.

sanskrit_iast: tasmādaṅgulibhiḥ kāryaṃ pramāṇaṃ sarvakarmasu
meaning: तस्मादङ्गुलिभिः कार्यं प्रमाणं सर्वकर्मसु
text_mt: Therefore, the measure in all rituals should be made in finger-breadths.

sanskrit_iast: maṇḍalena ca kīlena digādigrahaṇaṃ smṛtam
meaning: मण्डलेन च कीलेन दिगादिग्रहणं स्मृतम्
text_mt: The determination of the cardinal directions and so forth is taught by means of a circle and a pin.
